notes.awangaale: Ovu dria: may he stay forever.

guidebook.intro: The kingdom of Buganda. Titles like **Kabaka**, **Katikkiro** and **Lukiiko** are kept as they are.

tips.title: Kabaka ovu dria!
body: **Opi** is chief or king. **Kabaka ovu dria!** (may the Kabaka live on!) answered by **Ovu dria!**
**Opi jo** (king’s house) is the palace, **opi ce** the royal tombs.

tips.title: Ndra’bo ndra
body: **Ndra’bo ndra** (very long ago) begins history. **Kintu ovu ra Kabaka kakau ni** (Kintu was the first Kabaka).
**Abunuwasi** is the trickster of coastal stories.

culture.title: Chiefs in West Nile
body: The Lugbara traditionally had no king; rain-makers and clan elders (**opi**) led communities.
